units: <cite ref="Berakhot 6b:33">Ber. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>כאילו הקריב ת׳</he> as if he had offered a thank-offering.
<cite ref="Shevuot 15b:13">Shebu. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>שיר של ת׳ וכ׳</he> the song of thank-giving (in the Temple) was accompanied by citterns &c.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9:7">Lev. R. s. 9</cite> <he>חטאת … ת׳ אינה באה על חטא</he> the sin-offering is brought for a sin …, but not so the thank-offering.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9:7">Ib.</cite> <he>לעתיד … וקרבן ת׳ וכ׳</he> in future all sacrifices will cease, but the thank-offering shall never cease.
<cite ref="Menachot 80a:13">Ib. 80ᵃ</cite> <he>מרבה בת׳ הוא</he> he had the intention of bringing several thank-offerings. Lev. R. l. c.; a. e.
